title: HOW TO GET RID OF FRUIT FLIES | diy fruit fly trap super simple and effective
description:
Hey guys! With summer being here, I wanted to share my super simple quick tip on how to remove those pesky fruit flies from your home. Fruit flies are common especially in summer months so don't be ashamed if you find a few. 

What you need: 
Apple Cider Vinegar (I got mine from dollar tree)
sugar 
dish soap (whatever you have on hand will do)
mason jar
paper
